_note: Hand-written game content in the book's framing (Mars = men, Venus = women). 'for' = the planet the PLAYER is from; the moment comes from the other planet. Numbers and sources are joined in by scripts/build_content.py from research/.

ideas.name: Remember our differences
ideas.bookTitle: Men Are from Mars, Women Are from Venus

why.mars: Venusians share feelings to feel close. Don't expect her to act like a Martian.
why.venus: Martians think before they talk. Don't expect him to act like a Venusian.

actions.mars: Ask about her day, then just listen.
actions.venus: Give him quiet time without taking it personally.

scenarios.prompt: Venus wants to talk about her whole day.
Venus is hurt you forgot to call.
Mars goes quiet after a long day.
Mars answers 'fine' to everything.

ideas.name: No fixing, no improving
ideas.bookTitle: Mr. Fix-It and the Home-Improvement Committee

why.mars: Venus talks to feel better, not to get solutions. Don't play Mr Fix-It.
why.venus: Advice he didn't ask for feels like criticism to Mars. Don't try to 'improve' him.

actions.mars: When she vents, nod for 2 minutes. No fixes.
actions.venus: Hold back one piece of advice today.

scenarios.prompt: Venus: "My boss was awful today."
Venus: "I'm so tired of the commute."
Mars is lost but won't ask directions.
Mars is fixing the sink his way.
scenarios.miss: Tell him how to do it.

ideas.name: The cave
ideas.bookTitle: Men Go to Their Caves and Women Talk

why.mars: Going to your cave is OK. Tell her you'll come back.
why.venus: Martians go to their cave to think. Don't follow him in. He'll come back.

actions.mars: Say 'I need time to think. I'll be back.'
actions.venus: Let him have his cave. Do something you enjoy.

scenarios.prompt: You're stressed. Venus asks what's wrong.
Venus feels shut out by your silence.
Mars goes silent and stares at the TV.
Mars: "I just need to think."

ideas.name: Needed and cherished
ideas.bookTitle: How to Motivate the Opposite Sex

why.mars: On Venus, people try harder when they feel cared for. Show you care.
why.venus: On Mars, people try harder when they feel needed. Thank him for what he does.

actions.mars: Do one small thing that says 'I cherish you'.
actions.venus: Thank him for one thing he did today.

scenarios.prompt: Venus looks worn out after work.
scenarios.good: Make her a cup of tea.

scenarios.prompt: Venus mentions a scary appointment.
Mars fixed the wobbly table.
Mars offers to help with your move.

why.mars: When Venus says 'never', she means 'I feel unheard'. Don't argue the facts.
why.venus: When Mars says 'I'm fine', he means 'I'll handle it'. He isn't pushing you away.

scenarios.prompt: Venus: "We NEVER go out anymore!"
Venus: "You don't listen to me."
Mars: "I'm fine. It's nothing."
Mars: "Stop worrying about it."

why.mars: Pulling away and springing back is normal. Come back warm.
why.venus: Mars pulls away, then springs back. Don't chase him. Welcome him back.

actions.mars: After time alone, come back and ask about her day.
actions.venus: When he comes back, welcome him without blame.

scenarios.prompt: You pulled away all week. Now you're back.
You need some distance today.
scenarios.good: "I need a day. I love you."

scenarios.prompt: Mars has been distant for days.
Mars comes back, warm and loving again.

why.mars: Her mood rises and falls like a wave. At the bottom she needs you, not fixes.
why.venus: When your wave crashes, tell him you just need him to listen.

actions.mars: On her low day, stay close and listen.
actions.venus: On a low day, say 'I just need you to listen.'

scenarios.prompt: Venus feels low for no clear reason.
Venus: "Everything feels like too much."
You feel low. Mars offers a fix.
Your wave crashes. Mars looks worried.

why.mars: Venus needs care, understanding and respect. Give her what she needs, not what you'd want.
why.venus: Mars needs trust, acceptance and thanks. Give him what he needs, not what you'd want.

actions.mars: Show understanding: say back how she feels.
actions.venus: Show trust: let him decide one thing.

scenarios.prompt: Venus shares a worry about her mum.
Venus wants you at her friend's party.
Mars picked a restaurant. It's average.
Mars makes a choice about the car.

why.mars: Fights grow when Mars waves her feelings away. Say her feelings make sense first.
why.venus: Fights grow when Venus judges how Mars talks. Assume he means well first.

scenarios.prompt: Venus is upset. You think she overreacts.
A small disagreement starts heating up.
Mars forgot your errand.
Mars's tone sounds harsh to you.

ideas.name: Scoring points
ideas.bookTitle: Scoring Points with the Opposite Sex

why.mars: On Venus, a small gift scores as much as a big one. Do lots of little things.
why.venus: Mars scores points by doing things for you. Notice them. Let small slips go.

actions.mars: Do 3 small things: a hug, a note, a coffee.
actions.venus: Notice one thing he did and say so.

scenarios.prompt: A normal Tuesday evening.
Venus comes home tired.
Mars took the bins out unasked.
Mars makes a small mistake.

why.mars: Write down your anger, sadness, fear, regret, then love. Then talk.
why.venus: Write down your anger, sadness, fear, regret, then love. Then talk.

actions.mars: Angry? Write a 5-line Love Letter first.
actions.venus: Angry? Write a 5-line Love Letter first.

scenarios.prompt: Venus's comment made you furious.
You can't find words for a hurt.
Mars hurt you. You're about to explode.
A hard talk with Mars tonight.

ideas.name: Ask for support
ideas.bookTitle: How to Ask for Support and Get It

why.mars: When Venus asks, give a warm yes, or a kind no. No grumbling.
why.venus: Martians need to be asked. Ask briefly: 'Would you...?' Then say thanks.

actions.mars: When she asks, say a warm yes.
actions.venus: Ask once: 'Would you...?' Then thank him.

scenarios.prompt: Venus: "Would you take the bins out?"
Venus hints the car needs washing.
You want Mars to cook tonight.
You need help with the shopping.

ideas.name: Keep the magic alive
ideas.bookTitle: Keeping the Magic of Love Alive

why.mars: Love has seasons. Keep doing the little things from the start.
why.venus: Love has seasons. Keep doing the little things from the start.

actions.mars: Plan a small date like the early days.
actions.venus: Plan a small date like the early days.

scenarios.prompt: Six months in. Dates have stopped.
Venus misses the early days.
Mars seems bored with the routine.
Your anniversary is next week.
